event.title: Trump, Xi, and Putin to Hold Historic Meeting at APEC Summit in China
event.canonical_title: Trump, Xi, and Putin to Hold Historic Meeting at APEC Summit in China
event.summary: The leaders of the United States, China, and Russia are set to hold an unprecedented trilateral meeting on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China. This meeting marks the first formal gathering of the three leaders, with discussions expected to focus on nuclear weapons reduction. The meeting is scheduled for next week.

timeline.title: Trilateral Summit Yields Peace Declaration, Omits Ukraine and Iran Issues
timeline.summary: Leaders from the US, China, and Russia concluded an unprecedented trilateral summit with a joint peace declaration. The statement emphasized cooperation on UN reforms, fuel supplies, and nuclear risks but notably did not address the ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and Iran. This summit marks a significant diplomatic engagement among the three nations, yet it has drawn attention for its lack of focus on pressing geopolitical issues.
key_facts: Trilateral summit held between US, China, and Russia.
Joint peace declaration issued focusing on UN reforms and fuel supplies.
No mention of the wars in Ukraine and Iran in the declaration.
